reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent actually viewed the exact source, complete parent RGB raw, complete derived RGBA raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet, and naiwa reference; rechecked native-resolution cap, hair, eyes, mouth and collar details and independently verified parent/source/derived hashes, exact RGB identity, bilinear source-alpha mapping, corners, receipt and final-evidence/sheet bindings with read-only Python

entries.positive_observation: The derived RGBA preserves the approved parent art in full and in native detail. The dark green-black peaked cap retains its source top crop, glossy visor, gold piping and cords, upper gold eagle and separate lower gold wreath/cockade with a red-pale-dark center. Dark eyebrows, one narrow dark upper-lip moustache and a separate small central goatee remain, with exactly one stern closed mouth between them and smooth lateral cheeks and jaw. The eyes remain solid black with green rings; no glasses, human nose, ears or skin were added. The near-frontal pose, forward gaze, under-visor shadow and original chest crop remain. The dark uniform retains the bright white high standing collar and dark central tie/bow shape, with continuous short broad neck contact and no floating cloth, pinching or added cream bib. The full warm gray-beige painted backplate remains through every corner without a frame, note, halo or replacement studio.
entries.alpha_decision: Approve the derived RGBA for production. The source alpha was resized from 156x210 to 1776x2368 with BILINEAR and applied without changing any parent RGB pixel bytes. Independent read-only recomputation confirmed rgb_unchanged=true, alpha_matches_resized_source=true and the recorded resized-alpha hash. Source, resized and output corner alpha are all [249,249,255,255], and source/output alpha extrema are [249,255]. Complete white/cyan/alpha inspection shows the original near-opaque full-canvas backing with no visible holes, lost corners, working-matte ring or new exterior cutout; near-opaque internal values were not treated as defects. This is a derived alpha-repaired file, not a native transparent return.
entries.visible_limitations: The cap-emblem interiors, tiny chin-tuft boundary and exact dark necktie/bow construction are not fully separable at 156x210. Their visible major shapes and counts were rechecked, and no exact unreadable heraldry or writing is claimed.
